(0.08 million kg) in the period 2020¿-024, 1,000 slaughtered animals (0.1 million kg) in the period 2005-2019, and 1,000 slaughtered animals (1.7 million kg) prior to 2005.
notes.pigs: On June 24, 2026, data for 2025 has been revised for pig slaughters, but they are still not final. The number of slaughtered pigs are excl. discarded pigs. Export of live pigs, total are excl. breeding pigs. About 95 per cent of export of live animals are small pigs in the years 2011 and 2012, 96 - 97 per cent in 2013 - 2016 and 98 per cent since 2017.
